trigger: A fresh Android Termux session is being prepared for bounded AgentSwitchboard repository work.

steps.action: Read AGENTS.md, the root codebase map, canonical Android profile registry and this harness manifest before mutation.
steps.evidence: paths read and current profile status recorded

steps.action: Record uname -a, HOME, PREFIX, command -v results for git tmux gh ssh curl jq, and tool versions without exposing credentials.
Require a tmux session for repository work; verify detach, tmux ls, and reattach before credential or repository mutation.
Before diagnosing a missing command, reject literal bracketed-paste framing such as [200~ as an input-boundary failure and run command -v on the intended executable.
Name repository, branch, lane, owned scope, forbidden scope and one writer before changes.
Fetch current origin/main and create or use a non-default isolated feature branch; never use force or destructive cleanup.
Run the portable Android harness contract test before broader work when the repository is available.

failurePolicy: Preserve the tmux session and evidence, classify the exact failed boundary, repair only the owned boundary, then rerun the failed step before proceeding.
proofCeiling: Intake and environment readiness only; no credential, clone, branch write, launcher or product-runtime success is implied.
